title: Discovery Engine: AssistAnswer `connectorDisplayNames` is now read-only
summary: The `connectorDisplayNames` property in the `AssistAnswer` schema (v1 and v1alpha) is now `readOnly`. This is a breaking change for developers who were previously writing to this field, which provides human-readable names for internal connector agents.
details: The `connectorDisplayNames` property within both `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1AssistAnswer` and `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1alphaAssistAnswer` schemas has been updated to be `readOnly`. This means the field, intended to provide output-only mappings of internal connector agent identifiers to user-friendly display names, can no longer be modified via the API. Developers must adjust their integrations to treat `connectorDisplayNames` as an immutable, server-generated output.
